title: Reproduce an orbit.
prompt: Run the exact integer recurrence. Read the stopping reason, then select the only justified general interpretation.
hint: Starting at 6 reaches 1 after eight updates. A low budget can stop before reaching 1.

conclusions.text: A finite run can establish what happened for its declared start within its budget, but not for every positive integer.
A run that stops at its step budget is a counterexample to the conjecture.
Every orbit decreases at every step.

feedback.pass: A finite orbit and a universal statement have different scopes. A budget stop is preserved as inconclusive.
feedback.fail: The stopping budget is a computational limit, not a mathematical refutation.
